notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
The purpose of this update is to get RITE launching properly on Steam deck, without having to change any launch settings or anything. It appears to be running without issue on my end (works on my own Steam Deck), so hopefully that's the case for all SD owners.

I have also updated the library and store visual assets to match the Switch version.

Thanks,
Dan

notes.title: Patch 03
notes.content:
A small update has gone live, RITE is now available for Linux! 
And Cloud Saving has now been implemented too.
Also, last week RITE was a finalist in 3 categories at the Australian Game Developer Awards, and ended up winning Best Music and Best Emerging Game! So that's pretty cool!

Cheers,
Dan

notes.title: High-speed precision platformer 'RITE' adds Linux support in a post-release update
notes.content:
Ready for a fresh challenge? Conquered Celeste and want something more? Take a look at the high-speed precision platformer RITE which is now supported on Linux.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/10/high-speed-precision-platformer-rite-adds-linux-support-in-a-post-release-update

notes.title: RITE patch 02
notes.content:
The second major update for RITE is now live and includes:

- A level timer for quickest level times, both any% and all coins (timer display in options menu)
- A death counter (unfortunately doesn't include deaths previous to this update)
- Level names on level select screen, as well as best times
- The ability to clear your save file (death count and best times will remain saved, more just a feature for all coin full game speedrunners)
- Toggle outlines around the player, collectables, and hazards to make the game more readable
- Toggle wind effects and foliage animation to make the game more readable
- Holding the jump button when transitioning between levels with go to the next level straight away
- Fixed sound issues caused by global sound controls
- Fixed final achievement popping early
- Steam screenshots now implemented 

Thanks for playing RITE!
-Dan

notes.title: RITE patch 01
notes.content:
The first patch for RITE has been published. A small update addressing some of the most common feedback. Changes include:

- Added a jump buffer to both regular jumps and wall jumps
- Added coyote time to wall jumps (wall jumps feel a lot more natural)
- Reduced the player's maximum fall speed (only noticeable when falling full screen height)
- Added volume control for music
- Added volume control for sound effects
- Full screen and window switching
- Minor tweaks to a few levels

Thank you for playing RITE!
